player_0.content: New plan: I failed because I repeatedly guessed words containing the letters 'c', 'a', 'n', 'e', and 't', all of which were marked red (incorrect) except for 'r'. I ignored the feedback that 'r' is the only confirmed letter (in the second position) and kept cycling through variations of the same incorrect letters. Next time, I will immediately eliminate all red letters ('c', 'a', 'n', 'e', 't') from my vocabulary and construct guesses that place 'r' in the second position while testing new, unused consonants and vowels in the other four slots to quickly identify the remaining letters.
